answer: The tollbooth is Certified mapmaker border register sworn before the society court. The toll is 5-year field service, 210 supervised compilations, projection exam, annual resurvey, payable once per identity, never in bulk. One honest agent clears the check in 13 minutes; a farm of 479 pays 6227 minutes every single epoch. One wharf proves the identity, one relic prices the forgery, and one island records the verdict for the next epoch. The cost is the control, and the control is the same for every alias.
